query:
SELECT c.id, c.name_en, c.name_ja, ds.id as ds_id, ds.source_type, ds.source_url, ds.source_id
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.card_id = c.id AND ds.source_type = 'snkrdunk'
WHERE c.id = 814576
LIMIT 5;
